tolerance.note: IAPWS-IF97 (the simulator's Steam Tables) and IAPWS-95 (the reference) agree to about 0.01%; the other packages are reported against the same reference

scenarios.why: a larger temperature rise, still liquid: independent duty 293.182 kW
double the flow: both duties double (460.270 kW), which tests that the mass flow reaches the duty
heat through the boiling point to superheated steam at 1 atm: the duty includes the latent heat (2591.265 kW), and the cooler returns it to liquid; packages differ most here

feed at 301.325 kPa abs and a 100 kPa drop across the heater (outlet 201.325 kPa), which tests the sign of the pressure-drop parameter; duties from the independent calculation at those pressures (230.030 and 230.122 kW); the heater and the cooler no longer follow the same path (301 to 201 kPa while heating, 201 kPa while cooling), so the net duty is the difference of the two independent values, -333.3 kJ/h, not zero; the band is 2% around it

review.method: duties recomputed independently with CoolProp (IAPWS-95); temperatures and pressures are the specified values read back; net duty must vanish
